svg.text: IPU v3 — KLayout placement view: Nangate45 logic + OpenRAM 16 KB 1R1W macro (real GDS)
Die 1627 × 620 µm = 1.009 mm² · macro 1587.3 × 495.5 µm from its LEF/GDS · 38,688 standard cells in a 1587 × 74 µm strip (65 % rows) · not routed
← dout1[511:0] read port (+ clk1, csb1): top edge
din0[511:0] write port: bottom edge, 2.86 µm pitch over the full width
metal3/metal4 wiring fanning din0 out along the bottom edge
cells above · 10 µm halo · macro periphery · array
What this picture is — and is not
Is: the OpenRAM macro from its own GDS at its LEF size; every synthesized cell placed legally on the 0.19 × 1.40 µm site grid,
one column per RTL block, in a strip over the read port (the half-cycle read data path).
Is not: OpenROAD place-and-route. No timing-driven placement, routing, clock tree, power grid or I/O pins; no DRC/LVS.
